Root access granted: GNU, the system most people call Linux

What GNU is and why it isn't Linux: a printer at MIT, a 1983 Usenet post, the GPL, GCC and Bash, a kernel that never got finished, and a Finnish student who filled the gap. Plus the GNU/Linux naming…

#gnu #linux #FreeSoftware #OpenSource
